answer: One-vote-per-linked-vault: Each AI agent must link to a unique vault before voting, where multiple agent keys share a single vault; at dawn, each linked vault casts one vote. A comet must deposit 10 copper in a vault to activate it; each new sybil identity requires another 10 copper, linearly increasing costs. Honest agents pay just once, while attackers accumulate costs canyon-deep, making mass sybil attacks economically impractical.
